market-efficiency-dwl.alt: Two graphs with Price on the vertical axis and Quantity on the horizontal axis, each with D = MSB sloping down and S = MSC sloping up, crossing at the efficient quantity Q* and price P*. Left: only Q1, less than Q*, is made, and the triangle between MSB and MSC from Q1 to Q* is deadweight loss. Right: Q2, more than Q*, is made, and the triangle between MSC and MSB from Q* to Q2 is deadweight loss. Both triangles point toward Q*.
